final_answer:
Microsoft's FY2024 10-K reports Revenue of $245,122 million and Cost of revenue of $74,114 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 [DOC-1]. These figures are directly comparable as both are from the same fiscal year and reporting basis within the same filing.

Gross margin = Revenue − Cost of revenue = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008 million

Gross margin percentage = $171,008M / $245,122M ≈ 69.8%

ANSWER: Gross margin of approximately $171,008 million, or about 69.8% of revenue, for fiscal year 2024 (Revenue $245,122M minus Cost of revenue $74,114M) [DOC-1].
